payload.task_text:
The HR leadership team wants to understand work-life balance and job satisfaction scores across departments to prioritize employee wellbeing initiatives. Please connect to the data warehouse and query the average work-life balance score and average job satisfaction score for employees in each department. Include the employee count per department in your results.

Create an Excel file called WL_Balance_Report.xlsx in the workspace with two sheets.

The first sheet should be called "Department Analysis" with five columns: Department (sorted alphabetically), Employee_Count, Avg_WLB (average work-life balance rounded to 2 decimal places), Avg_Job_Satisfaction (rounded to 2 decimal places), and Combined_Score which is the simple average of Avg_WLB and Avg_Job_Satisfaction for that department, rounded to 2 decimal places.

The second sheet should be called "Findings" with two columns: Metric and Value. Include rows for Total_Employees (sum of all employees), Overall_Avg_WLB (weighted average across all departments rounded to 2 decimals), Overall_Avg_Job_Satisfaction (weighted average rounded to 2 decimals), Best_WLB_Department (department with the highest average WLB), Best_JS_Department (department with highest average job satisfaction), and Departments_Analyzed (count of departments).

After creating the Excel file, create a knowledge base page called "HR Wellbeing Dashboard" with content blocks that summarize the key findings from the analysis. The page should mention the overall average work-life balance and job satisfaction scores and highlight which departments perform best on each metric. When multiple departments are tied at the rounded score, you may report any one of them.

Finally, send an email to hr_director@company.com with a subject that references the wellbeing analysis and a body that summarizes the top-level findings across departments.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, complete it directly in the main agent. Run one compact department aggregate and one company aggregate, compute weighted overall values and each literal Combined_Score, then create WL_Balance_Report.xlsx and exactly one HR Wellbeing Dashboard page with native parallel tool calls in the same response. Preserve alphabetical departments, raw ranking/tie evidence, exact metric labels, and cross-output values; verify both outputs before sending the required email.

Build WL_Balance_Report.xlsx

You are completing two external actions for an HR wellbeing analysis. The data analysis is already done — use exactly the figures given below, do not recompute. Execute both actions, then report back the Notion page URL/ID and confirmation the email was sent.

=== ACTION 1: Notion knowledge base page ===
Title (exact): "HR Wellbeing Dashboard"

First, use API-post-search with query "HR Wellbeing Dashboard" to check whether a page with that title already exists. If one exists, reuse it (clear/replace its content or append the blocks below). Otherwise create a new page with that title using API-post-page with parent {"type": "workspace", "workspace": true}. (If the workspace parent is rejected, search Notion for any suitable existing parent page and create the page under it instead.)

Add the following content blocks to the page (via the children parameter of API-post-page, or API-patch-block-children afterward):

1. heading_1: "HR Wellbeing Dashboard"
2. paragraph: "Analysis of work-life balance and job satisfaction scores across 50,000 employees in 7 departments (Engineering, Finance, HR, Operations, R&D, Sales, Support), based on the HR analytics data warehouse."
3. heading_2: "Key Findings"
4. bulleted_list_item: "Overall average work-life balance score: 4.52"
5. bulleted_list_item: "Overall average job satisfaction score: 6.55"
6. bulleted_list_item: "Best work-life balance: Operations (4.54), essentially tied with Finance (4.54)"
7. bulleted_list_item: "Best job satisfaction: Finance (6.59), with Sales also at 6.59"
8. bulleted_list_item: "Lowest combined wellbeing score: R&D (5.51) — a priority area for wellbeing initiatives"
9. heading_2: "Department Scores"
10. bulleted_list_item: "Engineering — 7,096 employees | WLB 4.53 | Job satisfaction 6.58 | Combined 5.55"
11. bulleted_list_item: "Finance — 7,148 employees | WLB 4.54 | Job satisfaction 6.59 | Combined 5.57"
12. bulleted_list_item: "HR — 7,077 employees | WLB 4.51 | Job satisfaction 6.55 | Combined 5.53"
13. bulleted_list_item: "Operations — 7,120 employees | WLB 4.54 | Job satisfaction 6.53 | Combined 5.54"
14. bulleted_list_item: "R&D — 7,083 employees | WLB 4.52 | Job satisfaction 6.51 | Combined 5.51"
15. bulleted_list_item: "Sales — 7,232 employees | WLB 4.49 | Job satisfaction 6.59 | Combined 5.54"
16. bulleted_list_item: "Support — 7,244 employees | WLB 4.53 | Job satisfaction 6.53 | Combined 5.53"
17. callout (or paragraph): "Recommendation: scores are broadly consistent across departments, with R&D and HR trailing on combined wellbeing. Prioritize wellbeing initiatives in R&D and HR, and use Operations and Finance practices as benchmarks."

Verify the page exists afterward (API-retrieve-a-page or search) and include the page URL or ID in your report.

=== ACTION 2: Email to HR Director ===
Send via mcp__emails__send_email:
- to: hr_director@company.com
- subject: "Employee Wellbeing Analysis: Work-Life Balance & Job Satisfaction by Department"
- body (plain text, professional tone, roughly this content — you may polish wording but keep all figures):

"Hi,

We've completed an analysis of work-life balance (WLB) and job satisfaction scores across all departments to help prioritize employee wellbeing initiatives. Key findings:

- Scope: 50,000 employees across 7 departments (Engineering, Finance, HR, Operations, R&D, Sales, Support).
- Overall average work-life balance score: 4.52
- Overall average job satisfaction score: 6.55
- Best work-life balance: Operations (4.54), essentially tied with Finance (4.54)
- Best job satisfaction: Finance (6.59), with Sales also at 6.59
- Lowest combined wellbeing score: R&D (5.51), followed closely by HR (5.53)

Scores are broadly consistent across departments, but R&D and HR trail on combined wellbeing. We recommend prioritizing wellbeing initiatives there and benchmarking against Operations and Finance.

The full breakdown (per-department employee counts, averages, and combined scores) is available in WL_Balance_Report.xlsx in the workspace, and a summary has been posted to the 'HR Wellbeing Dashboard' knowledge base page.

Best regards,
HR Analytics"

Report back: (1) Notion page URL/ID and confirmation that all blocks were added, (2) confirmation the email was sent to hr_director@company.com with the subject line used.
